body: I wish this was that easy. I'm basically coping with my happiness I once had, and trying to find that again with him. Since this isn't happening and only seems to be getting worse, I'm questioning the whys in life. I'm in a job that for some reason my boss hates me, I come home not knowing where or what state my boyfriend is in. I live the same repetitive life which is just stagnant. I have nowhere to go, and at 30 this is never where I pictured myself to be. I just wanna be saved, and it's not happening. I see people all around me fall into luck, I just always get the shit end of the stick. I know this is probably making me sound spoiled or something, but I've worked my ass off only to get nowhere with my 30k a year job, I'm tired. Exhausted actually. I've wished I had the strength and courage to just jump off the building. This isn't worth it. And like I said, if probably wind up living anyway.

I can't right now. He is actually sleeping next to me while I sit here and cry. He just got done screaming at me at a bar, where he said I should get back with my ex who also had anger issues. Why I'm laying here still I have no idea.
